title: Enochian tale found in Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts

tellings.quote: the Enochian tale is attested not just in Enoch >> but in several Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts >> including the book of giants

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino says the story told in the ancient Jewish text called the Book of Enoch, about angels and giants, does not appear only in that book. He says it also turns up in several of the Dead Sea Scrolls, the ancient manuscripts found in caves at Qumran, including the Book of Giants, and in texts such as the Book of Jubilees and the Genesis Apocryphon, which to him shows how old and widespread the tale is.
